e: From Louisiana Creole zydéco, compare French zarico; possibly from a metanalysis of French les haricots (“beans”) as French le zarico (“beans”) in a dance-tune title.
q: Sunpie—in real life, a park ranger and an accordionist who leads a good zydeco band—taunted Harrison […].
